definitions.explanation: A formal rule or provision established by law, contract, or organization. Also used as a する verb meaning to stipulate or prescribe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{規定|きてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧。
examples.english: I follow the provisions of the law.

examples.japanese: {就業|しゅうぎょう}{規定|きてい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧30⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧だ。
examples.english: The work regulations limit overtime to 30 hours per month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{規定|きてい}⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Matters not stipulated in the contract will be discussed separately.

notes:
USAGE:
{規定|きてい} refers to specific rules or clauses within a larger system of regulations. Compare with ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧ (rules in general, often for everyday conduct), ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧ (law), and ⟦{規約|きやく}→規約：14184_kiyaku⟧ (terms, bylaws). {規定|きてい} tends to appear in formal and legal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {規定|きてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow regulations
- {規定|きてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to establish a regulation
- {規定|きてい}{違反|いはん}: violation of a regulation
- {規定|きてい}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: as prescribed/stipulated
- {服務|ふくむ}{規定|きてい}: service regulations
